subject: Orbit trial onramp — scope recap & responsibilities
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Orbit trial onramp — scope recap & responsibilities

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the kickoff:

Summary / success criteria (please confirm):
- Generate embeddings + semantic search over 6 months of product support tickets with <= 150ms P95 token latency for retrieval flows.
- End-to-end latency for summarization flows < 1s P95 for 1k token inputs.
- No customer data persists outside Orbit’s VPC; Redwood runs inference in a Private deployment.
- Quality target: TOP-1 retrieval precision >= 0.85 on your eval set (we'll take your 50 sample queries).

Evaluation plan & timeline (proposed):
1) Week 0 (this week) — finalize scope, owners, and procurement contact. (Action: Daniel to confirm owners and procurement email)
2) Week 1 — infra & connectivity: VPC peering, firewall rules, and sample data ingest.
3) Week 2 — smoke tests: embeddings and retrieval baseline; initial quality evaluation.
4) Weeks 3–4 — iterate on batching, quantization profile; final acceptance run and handoff docs.

Draft RACI for onboarding (high level):
- Orbit — App owner (R), test dataset & access (R), procurement (A/C)
- Redwood — Serving runtime & infra setup (A/R: Rishi), On-call for infra issues (C)
- Orbit Security — Security signoff (A), data flow review (C)
- CS/AM — Success criteria verification (C)

Open asks for you today:
- Confirm security owner name & email to iterate on the data flow diagram.
- Share 50 sample queries + gold answers for quality evaluation by EOD Monday.
- Procurement contact for MSA/POs so we can surface SOW/limits for Dedicated capacity.

Attachments: orbit_poc_scope.pdf (PDF, 2 pages) — scope draft

If that looks good I'll circulate a formal RACI + kickoff calendar invite.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@orbitanalytics.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Orbit trial onramp — scope recap & responsibilities

Camila —

Thanks, appreciate the clear summary. Confirming the success criteria above — agreed. A few notes:
- Security owner: Maya Ortiz (maya.ortiz@orbitanalytics.com) — she'll own the data flow review and SOC 2 evidence requests.
- Procurement: procurement@orbitanalytics.com (cc'd) — they will need an SOW + cost estimate for reserved capacity.
- We can share 50 sample queries by Monday morning; I will attach the dataset. (Attachment: orbit_sample_queries.json)

One ask: can Redwood provide a short runbook that lists required firewall ports, expected IP ranges, and the cert/key exchange process? We want to pre-clear the network team.

I'll review the scope doc and loop in legal if we need to accelerate MSA.

Thanks,
Daniel
VP, Platform Engineering
Orbit Analytics
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Orbit trial onramp — scope recap & responsibilities

Team — FYI forwarding Orbit's notes (below). Drafting an accountability grid for the kickoff. Please review and flag gaps.

Proposed accountability grid (concise):
- Infra (network, VPC peering, certs): Rishi (Redwood) — Owner
- Runtime tuning (batching, quantization): Redwood — Rishi / Runtime Eng
- App integration & dataset: Orbit — Daniel / App Team
- Security signoff & evidence: Orbit Security — Maya Ortiz (A)
- Procurement / legal: Orbit procurement & Redwood legal — Camila (C)
- Success criteria verification: Camila + Orbit CS (C)

Planned kickoff window: Nov 30 — Dec 3 (preferred). Rishi, can you confirm availability and whether a 45-min technical kickoff is enough to collect the network artifacts? If not, we should schedule a 90-min deep-dive.

Attachments: redwood_onramp_matrix.xlsx (XLSX)

Thanks,
Camila

Camila / Steph —

I can own the infra side. Quick checklist and proposals:
- Pre-kickoff: I'll send the network runbook (ports, IP ranges), a minimal TLS cert exchange doc, and our sample SSH key fingerprinting process. [Attachment: infra_kickoff_checklist.md]
- Capacity: For the expected load (support tickets + retrieval), I'll provision a dedicated GPU node pool and enable prefix/KV caching to meet the latency targets.
- Test harness: We'll run a seeded acceptance test (50 queries) and produce a short quality report (precision/recall) within 48 hours of ingest.
- Kickoff slot: Nov 30, 11:00AM PT works for me for a 60-minute tech kickoff — we can extend if Orbit needs deeper network time.

I will be point for post-kickoff infra tasks and on-call for the trial. Assign me the 'Responsible' role in the RACI.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
